commitResults.messageTitle: Rename chatbot to Bill and add greeting
Add support for echoing user input
Add support for storing and listing tasks
Add support for updating task status
Introduce Task model and chatbot helper commands
Refactor Bill to follow coding standard
commitResults.messageBody: Bill's main method handles several distinct responsibilities, which makes the command flow difficult to scan and extend. Extract focused helper methods and named constants so future commands can follow the SE-EDU coding conventions consistently.
Represent todos, deadlines, and events as task subtypes so each task can share completion behaviour while displaying its own type and timing details.

Move todo, deadline, and event parsing out of Bill so the chatbot interaction flow is not coupled to delimiter and substring details. This gives parsing and future validation one focused location without changing user-visible behaviour.

Make Task abstract and require each concrete subtype to provide its own type icon. This prevents accidentally creating an unclassified generic task and makes the model's three supported task types explicit.
